## Invoice Number (IN)

The immutable identity a customer quotes back at you. Snapshot pattern, same family as PO Number: the issuing command stamps it once via `nextInvoiceNumber()`; nothing recomputes it. A primitive StringField cannot carry containedExamples â see the linked Invoice INV-2026-114.

### Non-goals

No global counter service (year-scoped generator, documented in code). Wiring the existing Invoice card’s plain `invoiceNumber` StringField over to this typed field is additive follow-up on that shared block, deliberately not done here.
